senses.en: to make someone or something come closer
to interest or appeal to someone

example.en: The museum attracts many young visitors.
example.zh: 这家博物馆吸引许多年轻游客。

senses.en: to cause attention or a reaction

example.en: Her unusual story attracted widespread interest.
example.zh: 她不寻常的故事引起了广泛兴趣。
